title: Singers Sally Sweetland and Andy Roberts
summary: How they were found and what became of them.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Where did you get the singers that you had?

She was in Ray Charles--one of the Ray Charles Singers and just got with the band, I guess. We needed somebody and I asked Sally to come and she did.

And Andy Roberts was doing a TV show on WPIX, I think, with Mundy (phonetic spelling) and Mundy said come over and hear the guy and we went over and talked to him and he would come too.

Andy for years has been a sportscaster, a weatherman, in Norfolk, Virginia. He's a wonderful guy and a good singer too. I don't think we did justice to him on the records; it's too bad, but then with the band, his sort of singing went off with the rock scene too.
Yes; Norfolk, Virginia. He's been there for years.

Sally had been married to an opera singer who was drafted at the wrong moment and it wrecked his career, because he had been at the Met and when he came back they no longer--he was too old for it or something.

He began teaching and when Sally left the band that's what they did; they went to the coast. I don't know where he comes from, and they set up a studio, which they still run. I guess it's in North Hollywood. She's a vocal coach and he is too.
